quality_effect: Keeps coarse OS terrain, geodetic transformation error and WCS service semantics separate from parcel-scale elevation measurement evidence.

official_sources.title: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15
Web Coverage Service 2.0 Earth Observation Application Profile

official_facts: OS Terrain 50 is a low-resolution DTM for Great Britain.
The product is intended for broad applications over large areas.
OS Terrain 50 is available as grid data and in formats including ASCII, GML and GeoPackage.
OS Net base-station coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008m in plan and 0.020m in height.
OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid in conjunction with OS Net stations.
Agreement between OSTN15 and old triangulation network stations is 0.1m rms for Great Britain.
OSGM15 standard error in height for Great Britain is 0.008m, excluding GNSS heighting error.
OGC WCS 2.0 EO profile requires range subsetting support through the specified extension.
OGC WCS 2.0 EO profile also specifies scaling and interpolation extension dependencies.
